name: Fuuinjutsu — Sealing Power
action: Standard unless the seal specifies otherwise
description:
Prerequisites: Intelligence 6

Action: Standard unless the seal specifies otherwise

Chakra: By the chosen seal

Common Ninjutsu power, normally touch range. Storage Seals store objects or eligible jutsus in scrolls; Advanced Seals create consumable special tags. Individual seals have their own level, action and chakra requirements. Learning this power does not automatically prepare scrolls or tags. Epic Seals are a separate, highly secret/mostly Kinjutsu group and are outside these common seal lists.

name: Storage Seals — Scroll Rules
action: One round to store; release uses the stored content’s normal action
chakraCost: 1 per stored/retrieved equipment slot; jutsu storage 1 plus jutsu cost, and pay that jutsu again on release
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6

Action: One round to store; release uses the stored content’s normal action

Chakra: 1 per stored/retrieved equipment slot; jutsu storage 1 plus jutsu cost, and pay that jutsu again on release

A Jutsu Scroll costs 10 Ryo, occupies one equipment slot per unit and cannot be reused. Only one stored compartment or jutsu may be released per action; hold the scroll in hand. Weapons use a partial draw action; attacks use their normal attack action. Releasing objects needs no hand seals; releasing jutsus always requires seals even if the original jutsu did not. Anyone may release contents without Fuuinjutsu, but the user must meet the technique’s NC limit. A sealed restricted-element jutsu can only be used by someone possessing that same restricted power. Sealing it does not grant that power. Shadow/Wood clones may release objects; releasing jutsus requires True Clone. Cannot nest scrolls.

name: Storage Seal
action: One round to seal; release as the content requires
chakraCost: 1 per equipment slot for storage/retrieval; jutsu 1 plus its chakra, pay its chakra again on release
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 1

Action: One round to seal; release as the content requires

Chakra: 1 per equipment slot for storage/retrieval; jutsu 1 plus its chakra, pay its chakra again on release

Touch; permanent. Store up to 3 equipment compartments, or a technique using at most 3 chakra, or one Small-or-smaller object per compartment. May store your own or an ally’s techniques, including eligible continuous/permanent techniques already in the environment. Personal/touch, sustained and concentration techniques cannot be stored. Stored jutsus retain their creator’s parameters; ranged Ninpou/elemental attacks are released using the releaser’s Ranged Combat against the target’s defense. Apply the Storage Scroll Rules card for hand seals, release actions and compatibility.

name: Larger Storage Seal
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 2

Action: As Storage Seal

Chakra: As Storage Seal

Touch; permanent. Works as Storage Seal but holds 6 equipment compartments, or a technique with chakra equal to at most 1 plus the Fuuinjutsu level. From level 3, may store one Medium object occupying all compartments; from level 5, one Large object. All ordinary storage restrictions and release rules remain unchanged.

name: Advanced Seals — Preparation & Tag Rules
action: Full action to prepare unless the seal overrides; activation as listed
chakraCost: Preparation equals used seal level unless explicitly overridden; individual cards list special costs
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; appropriate seal level

Action: Full action to prepare unless the seal overrides; activation as listed

Chakra: Preparation equals used seal level unless explicitly overridden; individual cards list special costs

Prepare a special blank tag, normally before combat. Use the same Ryo cost and equipment-space rules as explosive tags. Advanced seals are single-use and only their creator may use them. Removing or destroying the tag ends its effect; slashing or fire damage destroys it. Do not confuse an ordinary advanced seal with a clan’s exclusive seals. Follow a seal’s specific preparation and activation costs where provided, particularly Bakudan and Chakra no Souin. These are rule cards: resolve preparation, activation, consumption and ongoing effects manually.

name: Misshi — Messenger Seal
prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 3; know recipient’s chakra signature
chakraCost: 3 (listed technique cost); see advanced preparation rules
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 3; know recipient’s chakra signature

Action: Standard

Chakra: 3 (listed technique cost); see advanced preparation rules

Permanent until played. Record a message of at most 20 words in your own language and tone. Assign a known chakra signature. When a creature with that signature touches the tag, the message plays and the tag self-destructs. The creator immediately knows that the message was played.

name: Bakudan — Bomb Seal
chakraCost: 1 per tag when created; half the used power level when activated
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 4

Action: Standard activation; preparation as listed

Chakra: 1 per tag when created; half the used power level when activated

Touch; permanent until used. Follow explosive-tag rules except: spherical explosion diameter 2m per used power level; damage 2 per used level; remote-activation resistance DC 9 + 2 × used level. Only one Bakudan may be used in an attack. Do not add ordinary extra-tag damage/DC bonuses. Meta-aptitudes such as Empower can apply if the required move action is spent when the tag actually explodes. May create a Mechanics trap, but its maximum damage still follows the trap rules.

name: Gensou no In — Illusion Seal
chakraCost: 5 (listed technique cost); see advanced preparation rules
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 5

Action: Standard

Chakra: 5 (listed technique cost); see advanced preparation rules

Permanent illusion at the tag’s location of one or more objects/creatures. Maximum dimensions: 1m per Intelligence level. An observer must interact with it to recognize the illusion. This is Ninjutsu, so Kai does not dispel it. Removing or destroying the tag ends the illusion.

name: Ninjutsu no Wana — Ninjutsu Trap
prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 6; Mechanics 10; an eligible known ranged Ninjutsu
chakraCost: 4 plus the stored Ninjutsu cost, paid when creating the trap
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 6; Mechanics 10; an eligible known ranged Ninjutsu

Action: One round to create

Chakra: 4 plus the stored Ninjutsu cost, paid when creating the trap

Permanent until triggered. Fixed trap area: circle diameter 0.5m per Intelligence. Store a ranged technique of power/effect level at most 8 and within your NC limit; restricted powers cannot be stored in this trap. Record your Ranged Combat attack roll when creating it. The first creature to cross the area defends against the recorded attack at −1 accuracy. Area techniques become a cone originating from the seal. Search/Readiness to detect it is DC 7 + 2 × power level, and requires some Occultism or Fuuinjutsu. Cannot be disarmed normally: the creator must cancel it, or someone must force activation.

name: Chakra no Souin — Chakra Containment Seal
prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 7; at least 15 current chakra before activation, including chakra held by Shadow Clones
chakraCost: Activation reduces creator’s chakra to 1; see preparation rules
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 7; at least 15 current chakra before activation, including chakra held by Shadow Clones

Action: Full action to activate

Chakra: Activation reduces creator’s chakra to 1; see preparation rules

Permanent, immovable seal on a stationary surface; cannot be placed on a moving object. Area: circle diameter 1m per Intelligence. On activation the entire area displays a dark-red archaic symbol. Every creature in the area loses 2 chakra per turn, whether or not standing on the seal. Does not affect the creator’s chakra signature, including matching clones, and cannot reduce a creature below 1 chakra.

name: Kekkai no In — Barrier Seal
description:
Prerequisites: Fuuinjutsu; Intelligence 6; power level 8

Action: Full

Chakra: 8 (listed technique cost); see preparation rules

Permanent invisible wall of chakra, 1cm thick, height and width 0.5m per Intelligence. Put the tag at a corner or the center. Wall cannot be moved, damaged or altered and blocks creatures/objects, providing cover without concealment. It does not stop time-space techniques or doujutsu. Moving, removing or destroying the tag ends the barrier. Kekkai means barrier here; this is a common advanced seal, not a Kekkei Genkai.

name: Iryou Ninjutsu — Medical Power
action: Standard to start; concentration to maintain
chakraCost: Used power level; follow normal concentration rules
description:
Prerequisites: Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6

Action: Standard to start; concentration to maintain

Chakra: Used power level; follow normal concentration rules

Common Ninjutsu / Chakra Control. Touch range; no hand seals. Concentrate chakra through the hands to accelerate healing. The patient and healer must stay motionless during treatment. The General Healing card lists recovery, self-treatment and condition removal. Specialized medical techniques have their own power-level and aptitude prerequisites; they are not free grants merely for importing this card.

name: Iryou Ninjutsu — General Healing
prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6
description:
Prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6

Action: Standard; concentration; touch

Chakra: Used power level

At the end of each turn of treatment, recover Vitality equal to used Iryou level + ceil(Medicine / 2). Add 1 for Expert: Medicine and another 1 for Innate Skill: Medicine, if actually possessed. Both healer and patient remain motionless. The first treatment turn cures bleeding and Chakra Scalpel tissue-cut conditions. Self-treatment heals half the normal amount below level 4; at used level 4 or higher that reduction no longer applies. Apply ordinary rounding and concentration rules; no hand seals.

name: Chakra no Mesu — Chakra Scalpel
prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 6; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6
action: Move to activate; attacks are touch techniques
chakraCost: Use the medical power’s cost rules; sustained
description:
Prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 6; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6

Action: Move to activate; attacks are touch techniques

Chakra: Use the medical power’s cost rules; sustained

Create chakra scalpels in both hands for surgery or offensive touch attacks. Lethal base damage is 2 per used power level. Multiattack is allowed with its ordinary base-damage division; Unarmed Block cannot defend against the scalpel. After three hits, target tests Vigor against DC 7 + used power level + half Medicine. Failure causes Slowed and Weakened from cut muscle tissue for the listed two-month duration; the book also permits one turn of Iryou treatment or one month of rest to cure it. Track hits and treatment manually.

name: In’yu Shoumetsu — Secret Recovery from Injuries
prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 6; Expert: Medicine; Innate Skill: Medicine; ordinary Iryou prerequisites
description:
Prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 6; Expert: Medicine; Innate Skill: Medicine; ordinary Iryou prerequisites

Action: Move; personal; instantaneous

Chakra: 1 chakra for each 2 Vitality healed

Defensively anticipate the incoming strike and immediately apply Iryou to yourself. No test; heal wounds up to the damage received from that attack, using the medical technique’s healing rules. Cannot be used against critical hits or area attacks. Once per day because of the strain from rapid cell regeneration; track daily use manually. No hand seals.

name: Shousen no Jutsu — Mystic Palm Technique
prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 7; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6
description:
Prerequisites: Iryou Ninjutsu 7; Medical Ninja aptitude; Spirit 6

Action: Standard; touch; concentration

Chakra: Use ordinary Iryou chakra costs

Control chakra to treat an affected area at the ordinary Iryou healing rate. Offensive use disrupts chakra circulation: target tests Vigor against DC 7 + used power level + half Medicine. Failure stuns until the end of its next turn. On a critical failure, repeat the resistance test; another failure makes the target unconscious. No hand seals. This technique does not automatically grant medical aptitudes or restricted regeneration powers.
